run_python_code_in_sandbox: run Python code in an isolated sandbox using the ForkServer-based python tool executor
create_tool_executor_with_python: create a ToolExecutor with the python tool registered via python_tool() for sandboxed code execution
execute_tool_calls_from_text: execute tool calls from assistant text by parsing angle-bracket tags with ToolExecutor.maybe_exec_tools
create_python_tool_with_limits: create a python tool with a maximum execution count using python_tool_limits to cap sandbox runs
generate_system_prompt_with_tools: generate a system prompt that includes available tool descriptions using ToolExecutor.system_prompt
